smoking_intensity.recipe: step function on cotinine ng/mL: <10 -> 0, <100 -> 1, <200 -> 2, else 3

comorbidity_index.recipe: count of the 22 items answered 'yes' (code 1), divided by 22; told_diabetes also counts code 3 (borderline); missing items default to 'no'

self_reported_health_index.recipe: ((health == 4) * 2 + (health == 5) * 4) * (1 - (versus == 1) * 0.5 + (versus == 2)); missing defaults are health = 3 and versus = 3, giving 0

healthcare_use_index.recipe: the raw HUQ050 visit-count code used as a number, with 77, 99 and missing mapped to 0

ldl_cholesterol.recipe: Friedewald: total_cholesterol - triglycerides / 5 - hdl_cholesterol, in mmol/L. The /5 divisor is the mg/dL constant applied to mmol/L inputs; that is what the reference does. The reference substitutes 0 when any input is missing

urine_albumin_creatinine_ratio.recipe: urine_albumin / (urine_creatinine * 1.1312e-4), mg albumin per g creatinine
